easy: Already started and still going on.

ex.en: The soccer game is already underway.
ex.ko: 축구 경기는 이미 진행 중이다.

easy: Joined together so everything works as one.

ex.en: The class made a unified plan to clean the park.
ex.ko: 반 친구들은 공원을 청소하려고 하나로 뭉친 계획을 세웠다.

easy: Not steady. It could change or fall easily.

ex.en: The wobbly table is unstable, so be careful.
ex.ko: 그 흔들리는 탁자는 불안정하니까 조심해.

easy: On the floor above you in a building.

ex.en: My bedroom is upstairs.
ex.ko: 내 방은 위층에 있다.

easy: Not clear. Hard to understand exactly.

ex.en: His answer was vague, so I did not know what he meant.
ex.ko: 그의 대답이 모호해서 나는 무슨 뜻인지 몰랐다.

easy: Not exact. You are not sure about the details.

ex.en: I have only a vague idea where my shoes are.
ex.ko: 나는 내 신발이 어디 있는지 막연하게만 안다.

easy: Very small.

ex.en: A wee kitten slept in the box.
ex.ko: 아주 작은 새끼 고양이가 상자에서 자고 있었다.

easy: A very big amount, more than you need.

ex.en: In summer our garden has an abundance of tomatoes.
ex.ko: 여름에는 우리 텃밭에 토마토가 아주 풍성하다.

easy: Moving ahead toward the front.

ex.en: The advancing storm clouds made us run inside.
ex.ko: 다가오는 폭풍 구름 때문에 우리는 안으로 뛰어갔다.

easy: A tiny insect that lives with many others in a nest and works as a team.

ex.en: An ant carried a crumb across the sidewalk.
ex.ko: 개미 한 마리가 빵 부스러기를 들고 인도를 건넜다.

easy: Very old and special because of how old it is.

ex.en: Grandma keeps an antique clock in the living room.
ex.ko: 할머니는 거실에 오래된 골동품 시계를 두고 계신다.

easy: Being free to make your own choices.

ex.en: Our teacher gave us the autonomy to pick our own books.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리가 읽을 책을 스스로 고르게 해 주셨다.

easy: Having to do with the way people or animals act.

ex.en: Our dog has a behavioral problem: he chews shoes.
ex.ko: 우리 개는 신발을 씹는 행동 문제가 있다.

easy: Asking a place ahead of time to keep a spot for you.

ex.en: We made a booking for dinner at six.
ex.ko: 우리는 여섯 시 저녁 식사를 예약했다.

easy: A man chosen by the people to help make laws for the country.

ex.en: The congressman visited our school.
ex.ko: 하원 의원이 우리 학교를 방문했다.

easy: Working together with others for the same goal.

ex.en: The class did a cooperative project to build a model volcano.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 함께 화산 모형을 만드는 협동 과제를 했다.

easy: A reporter who sends news stories from a faraway place.

ex.en: The news correspondent told us about the storm from Florida.
ex.ko: 뉴스 특파원이 플로리다에서 폭풍 소식을 전했다.

easy: A small paper that saves you money when you buy something.

ex.en: Mom used a coupon to get cheaper cereal.
ex.ko: 엄마는 쿠폰을 써서 시리얼을 더 싸게 샀다.

easy: Cloth that hangs over a window.

ex.en: The cat hid behind the curtain.
ex.ko: 고양이가 커튼 뒤에 숨었다.

easy: A doctor who takes care of your teeth.

ex.en: The dentist said I brush very well.
ex.ko: 치과 의사 선생님이 나는 양치를 아주 잘한다고 하셨다.

easy: A soft thick mix of flour and water that is baked into bread or cookies.

ex.en: We rolled the dough flat to make cookies.
ex.ko: 우리는 쿠키를 만들려고 반죽을 납작하게 밀었다.

easy: A paper cover that you put a letter in.

ex.en: I put the birthday card in an envelope.
ex.ko: 나는 생일 카드를 봉투에 넣었다.

easy: To slowly get harder to see until it is gone.

ex.en: The rainbow began to fade.
ex.ko: 무지개가 서서히 사라지기 시작했다.

easy: To lose color and strength, like a flower that is dying.

ex.en: The flowers began to fade because nobody gave them water.
ex.ko: 아무도 물을 주지 않아서 꽃이 시들기 시작했다.

easy: A very tired feeling in your body or mind.

ex.en: After the long hike I felt fatigue in my legs.
ex.ko: 긴 하이킹 뒤에 나는 다리에 피로를 느꼈다.

easy: Made up in a story; not real.

ex.en: Hogwarts is a fictional school.
ex.ko: 호그와트는 이야기 속에만 있는 학교다.

easy: Made up in the mind; not true.

ex.en: The boy told a fictional story about why he was late.
ex.ko: 그 아이는 늦은 이유로 꾸며낸 이야기를 했다.

easy: The outer edge of something.

ex.en: Sheep were eating grass on the fringe of the forest.
ex.ko: 양들이 숲 가장자리에서 풀을 먹고 있었다.

easy: The part of a town that is far from the middle.

ex.en: Our new house is on the fringe of town.
ex.ko: 우리 새 집은 마을 변두리에 있다.

easy: Leaves and stems of plants that people eat.

ex.en: Mom told me to eat my greens.
ex.ko: 엄마는 나에게 푸른 채소를 먹으라고 하셨다.

easy: A small book with facts and tips about one subject.

ex.en: The camp handbook lists all the rules.
ex.ko: 캠프 안내서에 모든 규칙이 적혀 있다.

easy: Strong and able to handle hard work and tough times.

ex.en: The hardy hikers walked all day in the cold.
ex.ko: 튼튼한 등산객들은 추위 속에서 하루 종일 걸었다.

easy: Able to live through cold or bad weather.

ex.en: Hardy flowers stay alive all winter.
ex.ko: 강인한 꽃들은 겨울 내내 살아남는다.

easy: Nice, and makes you want to come in or try it.

ex.en: The warm, inviting kitchen smelled like cookies.
ex.ko: 따뜻하고 아늑한 부엌에서 쿠키 냄새가 났다.

easy: When the opposite of what you expect happens, often in a funny or sad way.

ex.en: The irony was that the fire station caught on fire.
ex.ko: 아이러니하게도 소방서에 불이 났다.

easy: All the courts and judges of a country that decide what the law means.

ex.en: Judges are part of the judiciary.
ex.ko: 판사는 사법부의 일원이다.

easy: Full of energy and fun.

ex.en: My lively puppy runs around all day.
ex.ko: 우리 활기찬 강아지는 하루 종일 뛰어다닌다.

easy: Put down below the usual place.

ex.en: She looked at the floor with lowered eyes.
ex.ko: 그녀는 눈을 내리깔고 바닥을 보았다.

easy: A woman whose job is to clean a house or hotel.

ex.en: The hotel maid changed the towels.
ex.ko: 호텔 청소 담당 직원이 수건을 갈아 주었다.

easy: Knowing right from wrong and choosing to do what is right.

ex.en: Returning a lost wallet shows good morality.
ex.ko: 잃어버린 지갑을 돌려주는 것은 높은 도덕성을 보여 준다.

easy: Sure to die someday, like all living things.

ex.en: All people and animals are mortal.
ex.ko: 모든 사람과 동물은 언젠가 죽는다.

easy: A group that helps people instead of making money for its owners.

ex.en: The animal shelter is a nonprofit that cares for lost pets.
ex.ko: 동물 보호소는 길 잃은 반려동물을 돌보는 비영리 단체다.

easy: A truck with an open back for carrying things.

ex.en: Dad loaded the firewood into the back of his pickup.
ex.ko: 아빠는 픽업트럭 뒤에 장작을 실었다.

easy: Flowing out fast and in large amounts.

ex.en: We ran inside because of the pouring rain.
ex.ko: 쏟아지는 비 때문에 우리는 안으로 뛰어갔다.

easy: Respected by many people because it is very important or special.

ex.en: She won a prestigious prize for her painting.
ex.ko: 그녀는 그림으로 권위 있는 상을 받았다.

easy: The distance from the middle of a circle to its outside edge.

ex.en: The radius of the pizza is six inches.
ex.ko: 그 피자의 반지름은 6인치다.

easy: A straight line from the middle of a circle to its outside edge.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a circle and marked its radius in red.
ex.ko: 선생님이 원을 그리고 반지름을 빨간색으로 표시하셨다.

easy: Up above the line where the sky meets the land or sea.

ex.en: The risen sun warmed the beach.
ex.ko: 떠오른 해가 해변을 따뜻하게 했다.

easy: A long paper that is rolled up.

ex.en: The pirate unrolled an old scroll to find the map.
ex.ko: 해적은 오래된 두루마리를 펼쳐 지도를 찾았다.

easy: To ride on ocean waves while standing on a long board.

ex.en: My cousin learned to surf in Hawaii.
ex.ko: 내 사촌은 하와이에서 서핑을 배웠다.

easy: To look around on the internet without searching for one thing.

ex.en: I like to surf the web for funny animal videos.
ex.ko: 나는 웃긴 동물 영상을 보려고 인터넷 서핑을 하는 걸 좋아한다.

easy: Standing for an idea; being a sign of something.

ex.en: A white dove is symbolic of peace.
ex.ko: 흰 비둘기는 평화를 상징한다.

easy: To make two things happen together at the same time.

ex.en: I synced my watch with the school clock.
ex.ko: 나는 내 시계를 학교 시계에 맞췄다.

easy: A person who gives part of the money they earn to the government.

ex.en: Taxpayers help pay for our school and parks.
ex.ko: 납세자들은 우리 학교와 공원 비용을 내는 데 도움을 준다.

easy: To push something hard and fast.

ex.en: He thrust his hand into the bag and grabbed the ball.
ex.ko: 그는 가방에 손을 쑥 넣어 공을 움켜쥐었다.

easy: To push something into a small space.

ex.en: I thrust my homework into my backpack.
ex.ko: 나는 숙제를 가방에 쑤셔 넣었다.

easy: Three books or movies that tell one big story together.

ex.en: I read the whole trilogy in one summer.
ex.ko: 나는 한 여름 동안 3부작을 다 읽었다.

easy: The address you type to go to a website.

ex.en: Type the URL into the browser to open the game.
ex.ko: 브라우저에 인터넷 주소를 입력하면 게임이 열린다.

easy: A chair on big rolling parts that helps someone who cannot walk well move around.

ex.en: My grandpa uses a wheelchair to go around the park.
ex.ko: 우리 할아버지는 공원을 돌아다닐 때 휠체어를 타신다.

easy: Happening together with something else.

ex.en: The thunder and its accompanying lightning scared the dog.
ex.ko: 천둥과 함께 친 번개가 개를 놀라게 했다.

easy: Chosen for no good reason, just because someone felt like it.

ex.en: The coach's choice of team captain seemed arbitrary.
ex.ko: 코치가 주장을 뽑은 것은 아무 이유 없이 정한 것 같았다.

easy: A machine, often outside a bank, that gives you money when you use a card.

ex.en: Mom took money out of the ATM.
ex.ko: 엄마는 ATM에서 돈을 찾았다.

easy: Free and able to run itself.

ex.en: The island is autonomous and has its own leaders.
ex.ko: 그 섬은 자치적이라서 자기들만의 지도자가 있다.

easy: To make fun of someone again and again to upset them.

ex.en: Don't bait your little brother just to make him cry.
ex.ko: 울리려고 동생을 약 올리지 마라.

easy: To put food on a hook or trap to catch an animal.

ex.en: Dad baited the hook with a worm.
ex.ko: 아빠는 낚싯바늘에 지렁이를 미끼로 끼웠다.

easy: Someone who writes posts on a website about things they like.

ex.en: My aunt is a blogger who writes about travel.
ex.ko: 이모는 여행에 대해 글을 쓰는 블로거다.

easy: Having to do with the religion that follows the teachings of Buddha.

ex.en: We saw a Buddhist temple on our trip to Korea.
ex.ko: 우리는 한국 여행에서 불교 사찰을 보았다.

easy: A person who follows the teachings of Buddha.

ex.en: My friend's grandmother is a Buddhist and visits a temple.
ex.ko: 내 친구의 할머니는 불교 신자라서 절에 가신다.

easy: Cutting out parts of books, movies, or letters so people cannot see them.

ex.en: Some countries use censorship to stop people from reading certain books.
ex.ko: 어떤 나라는 사람들이 특정 책을 읽지 못하게 검열을 한다.

easy: To make something easier to understand.

ex.en: Our teacher clarified the rules of the game.
ex.ko: 선생님이 게임 규칙을 분명하게 설명해 주셨다.

easy: A book or collection made by putting many pieces together.

ex.en: This CD is a compilation of my favorite songs.
ex.ko: 이 CD는 내가 좋아하는 노래들을 모은 모음집이다.

easy: A person who writes music.

ex.en: Beethoven was a famous composer.
ex.ko: 베토벤은 유명한 작곡가였다.

easy: To be the parts that together form something.

ex.en: Twenty students constitute our class.
ex.ko: 스무 명의 학생이 우리 반을 이룬다.

easy: Writing letters back and forth with someone.

ex.en: My pen pal and I keep up our correspondence every month.
ex.ko: 나는 펜팔 친구와 매달 편지를 주고받는다.

easy: Good enough that people want to have it.

ex.en: A house near the park is very desirable.
ex.ko: 공원 근처 집은 아주 탐난다.

easy: Causing so much damage that almost everything is ruined.

ex.en: The hurricane was devastating to the little town.
ex.ko: 허리케인은 그 작은 마을에 엄청난 피해를 주었다.

easy: To decide not to listen to or think about something.

ex.en: He dismissed my idea without even listening.
ex.ko: 그는 내 생각을 듣지도 않고 무시했다.

easy: More far away; not as close.

ex.en: My school is farther from home than the park.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 공원보다 집에서 더 멀다.

easy: Showing that you like or agree with something.

ex.en: The teacher gave a favorable reply to our idea.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리 아이디어에 호의적으로 대답하셨다.

easy: Good for what you want to do.

ex.en: Favorable winds helped the sailboat go fast.
ex.ko: 순풍 덕분에 돛단배가 빨리 갔다.

easy: The belief that women and men should have the same rights.

ex.en: In class we learned how feminism helped women win the right to vote.
ex.ko: 수업에서 페미니즘이 여성의 투표권 획득에 어떻게 도움이 되었는지 배웠다.

easy: A liquid fuel that makes cars go.

ex.en: Dad filled the car with gasoline.
ex.ko: 아빠는 차에 휘발유를 넣었다.

easy: Having to do with the people who run a country or town.

ex.en: The mayor's office is a governmental building.
ex.ko: 시장 사무실은 정부 기관 건물이다.

easy: A boy who is the son of your son or daughter.

ex.en: Grandpa took his grandson fishing.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 손자를 낚시에 데려갔다.

easy: Missing some parts; not whole.

ex.en: My puzzle is incomplete because one piece is lost.
ex.ko: 조각 하나를 잃어버려서 내 퍼즐은 미완성이다.

easy: Not done yet.

ex.en: My homework is still incomplete.
ex.ko: 내 숙제는 아직 끝나지 않았다.

easy: To make something a part of a bigger thing.

ex.en: She incorporated her brother's idea into the science project.
ex.ko: 그녀는 오빠의 아이디어를 과학 프로젝트에 포함시켰다.

easy: Stopped for a while, but will start again.

ex.en: We finished the interrupted game after the rain.
ex.ko: 우리는 비 때문에 중단된 경기를 비가 그친 뒤 마저 했다.

easy: Starting and stopping again and again.

ex.en: I had interrupted sleep because of the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍 때문에 나는 자꾸 잠이 깼다.

easy: The hard white material in the long tusks of elephants.

ex.en: Many countries ban the sale of ivory to protect elephants.
ex.ko: 많은 나라가 코끼리를 보호하려고 상아 판매를 금지한다.

easy: To make fun of someone by copying them in a mean way.

ex.en: Don't mock your classmates when they make a mistake.
ex.ko: 반 친구가 실수해도 놀리지 마라.

easy: A chain or string of beads that you wear around your neck.

ex.en: Mom wore a pearl necklace to the party.
ex.ko: 엄마는 진주 목걸이를 하고 파티에 가셨다.

easy: Shown in a picture or drawing.

ex.en: The brave knight is portrayed on the castle wall.
ex.ko: 용감한 기사가 성벽 그림에 그려져 있다.

easy: A time when many people lose jobs and businesses make less money.

ex.en: During the recession, many shops closed.
ex.ko: 경기 침체 동안 많은 가게가 문을 닫았다.

easy: The top edge of a round thing like a cup.

ex.en: Milk dripped over the rim of my glass.
ex.ko: 우유가 유리잔 가장자리로 넘쳐흘렀다.

easy: The metal ring on a basketball hoop that holds the net.

ex.en: The ball hit the rim and bounced off.
ex.ko: 공이 림에 맞고 튕겨 나갔다.

easy: Used to say the next thing after the first one.

ex.en: First, wash your hands. Secondly, sit down to eat.
ex.ko: 먼저 손을 씻어. 두 번째로, 앉아서 먹어.

easy: Having to do with the line of bones down your back.

ex.en: Swimming is good for your spinal health.
ex.ko: 수영은 척추 건강에 좋다.

easy: A curve that goes around and around, getting bigger or smaller.

ex.en: The snail's shell makes a spiral.
ex.ko: 달팽이 껍데기는 나선 모양이다.

easy: A shape that winds around and around like a spring.

ex.en: The spiral staircase winds up to the top of the tower.
ex.ko: 나선형 계단이 탑 꼭대기까지 빙빙 올라간다.

easy: The wet liquid in your mouth.

ex.en: Chewing makes more spit in your mouth.
ex.ko: 씹으면 입 안에 침이 더 많이 생긴다.

easy: To make water fly about in drops.

ex.en: I splashed water on my sister at the pool.
ex.ko: 나는 수영장에서 언니에게 물을 튀겼다.

easy: Moving your arms and legs to make your muscles longer and looser.

ex.en: We do stretching before soccer practice.
ex.ko: 우리는 축구 연습 전에 스트레칭을 한다.

easy: A character in comics or movies who has amazing powers and saves people.

ex.en: My favorite superhero can fly.
ex.ko: 내가 좋아하는 슈퍼히어로는 하늘을 날 수 있다.

easy: Helping a sick or hurt person get better.

ex.en: Swimming is therapeutic for my sore knee.
ex.ko: 수영은 아픈 내 무릎을 낫게 해 준다.

easy: Happening at just the right time.

ex.en: The teacher gave us a timely reminder about the test.
ex.ko: 선생님은 시험에 대해 때맞춰 알려 주셨다.

easy: A round red fruit that people eat in salads and on pizza.

ex.en: I grew a juicy tomato in our garden.
ex.ko: 나는 우리 텃밭에서 즙 많은 토마토를 키웠다.
